name: TRIZ Principle 19: Periodic Action
sprint: Identify an operation that runs continuously. Redesign it to execute in short, intense bursts followed by extended low-energy hibernation states.
mechanism: Temporal pulse modulation. Counters the cognitive assumption of continuous operations by replacing steady-state processes with pulsed, periodic, or interleaved interventions.
questions: Why drain energy via continuous polling when periodic pulsed synchronization achieves equivalent functional fidelity?
What happens if operational frequency is modulated based on the volatility of the observed metric?
How can periodic micro-pulses be used to reset cumulative memory fragmentation or thermal buildup?
example: Ultra-Low-Power Biomedical IoT Wearables. Continuous biosensor telemetry drains coin-cell batteries within 8 hours. Applying Periodic Action: the sensor operates in a sub-milliamp sleep state for 990 milliseconds, wakes for 10 milliseconds to capture biological metrics, compresses the data into a burst buffer, transmits an encrypted BLE packet, and hibernates, extending operational battery longevity from 8 hours to 34 days.
